name: year-picker
purpose: Enter a calendar year (an integer 1-9999) in one four-digit segment inside a labelled group, or pick one from a non-modal dialog popup with a grid of the ten years of a decade (paged by decade), with min/max bounds, unavailable years, localized validation, and native form submission as a zero-padded YYYY.
whenToUse: A calendar year on its own: a model year, a graduation year, a tax or reporting year.
Users should be able to type a year quickly and also browse nearby years.
Year fields with bounds or unavailable years.
whenNotToUse: A month or a specific day: use Month Picker, Date Picker, or Date Input.
A calendar quarter: use Quarter Picker.
A fiscal year that does not start in January: the value is a calendar year; label the field accordingly or store the fiscal mapping yourself.
An arbitrary number that is not a year: use Number Input.
responsive: The group hugs its segment and the button, up to 100% of the container. The popup is positioned under the group (bottom-start) by the positioning engine, is at most the viewport width minus a gutter, caps its height to the available space, and scrolls when taller. Density tokens adjust the control height.
rtl: The year segment renders as an LTR-isolated run in every direction. The button sits at the inline end of the group. The popup and grid take the resolved direction: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in the grid are mirrored, the page chevrons are flipped, and the popup aligns to the inline start of the group.
theme: Control surface, border, focus, error, hover, selected, primary, and sunken-surface role tokens. The focused segment uses the selected pair; the selected year uses color-primary / color-on-primary; the current year is bold with an inset strong border; unavailable years are muted and struck through, so no state relies on color alone. Forced-colors mode uses Highlight for the focused segment and the selected year, a CanvasText outline for the current year, GrayText for disabled cells and buttons, and a CanvasText popup border.
timezone: Values are plain year numbers (no timezone) and never shift. The configured timezone (default UTC, never the host zone) only decides the current year: the cell marked aria-current, the year focused when the popup opens on an empty field, and the start of ArrowUp/ArrowDown in an empty segment. The advanced `today` option pins it to a fixed PlainDate.
security: Label, help text, segment name, cell text, headings, and messages are rendered with textContent and Intl formatting; no HTML parsing. Validation messages never include the entered value; range messages include only the formatted bounds. The popup uses the Popover API; no inline handlers. CSP-safe: positioning writes styles through the CSSOM.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. When `name` is set, a hidden input carries the year as four zero-padded digits (YYYY, for example 0005); it is empty while the entry is empty or fails a built-in check, and disabled (not submitted) while the picker is disabled. A read-only picker is submitted.

performance.testedScale: 100 instances per page in the performance test; the popup grid (10 cells) is created once per picker and re-rendered per page.

limitations: Gregorian (proleptic) years 1 to 9999 only; year 0 and negative years are not supported.
The year must be typed with four digits (0005 for year 5).
Only ASCII digits are accepted; other characters are removed.
Single years only; year ranges need two pickers.
The popup has no Cancel/OK buttons: picking a year commits it.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
unsupported: Rendering HTML in the label, help text, cells, or messages.
Fiscal years with a non-January start, eras, or non-Gregorian calendars.
Custom cell content or a custom grid layout.
antiPatterns: Using a Year Picker for an arbitrary integer; use Number Input.
Storing the displayed year text instead of the number or its YYYY form value.
Making the grid the only entry path; the segment stays available for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Relying on the host timezone for the current year; configure `timezone`.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/year-picker: AuiYearPicker directive ([auiYearPicker]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/year-picker: AuiYearPicker component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
